name: snowtime
title: Snowtime
description: Control your Snowtime timer, browse entries, and see the running time.
author: kustav_prants

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.description: Start a timer, from a recent entry or a new description.

commands.name: continue-timer
commands.title: Continue Timer
commands.description: Start a timer from your running or newest entry, with any changes.

commands.name: recent-entries
commands.title: Recent Entries
commands.description: Browse your entries of the last 14 days and start any of them again.

preferences.name: mergeTickets
preferences.title: Merge Tickets
preferences.label: Merge a day's entries with the same ticket
preferences.description: Show a day's entries with the same ticket as one row, with their total time. Entries without a ticket stay separate.

commands.name: running-timer
commands.title: Running Timer
commands.description: Show the running timer's elapsed time in the menu bar, and stop it or start another.

preferences.name: showStartAgain
preferences.title: Show Start Again
preferences.label: Show recent entries to start again
preferences.description: Lists five recent entries in the menu, to start one again with ⌘1–⌘5.

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: Instance URL
preferences.description: The address of your Snowtime, such as https://snowtime.snowhound.eu.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: A personal API key. Create one in Snowtime under Settings → API keys: a read key shows your entries and timer, a write key also starts and stops timers.

preferences.name: suggestionRange
preferences.title: Suggestions From
preferences.description: How far back Start Timer looks for entries to suggest.

preferences.name: timeFormat
preferences.title: Time Format
preferences.description: How times show, such as when a timer started.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
